Course catalogues are lists; curricula are graphs. This app lets students see the
Applied Mathematics & Statistics offerings at Johns Hopkins as the dependency structure they
actually are --- which courses unlock which, and what a path through the major looks like.

Built quickly, mostly to answer advising questions I kept getting asked in person.
